description: Soulcraft is an SEO agency that puts businesses in the answers their customers are looking for, in Google and AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. These read-only WebMCP tools run in the visitor's browser on soulcraftagency.com and describe Soulcraft's services, pricing, method and contact options, and return site pages as markdown.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Overview of Soulcraft: what it does, who leads the work, where it is based, how to get in touch, and the main pages.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Soulcraft services, its five-step method, and published monthly pricing (core engagement and add-ons).

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Return a page on soulcraftagency.com as markdown, for reading without the page chrome.

tools.name: send_inquiry
tools.description: Declarative form tool on https://soulcraftagency.com/contact/: send Soulcraft a project inquiry (name, work email, company, website, budget range, message). Submitted through the visible form in the visitor's browser.
